text: @koanjan/dsh-plugin-boundary 是面向 DSH 插件开发者的技能插件，适用于 Web 客户端配置的 profile bundle。它通过 Cordis profile patch 加入插件，并注册一个可由模型或用户调用的技能，按需读取技能说明和四份规则文档。内容涵盖 Client 与 Host 通信通道、官方文件系统 API 能力、动态插件和 bundle 生命周期，以及安装生效和调试方法。适合在设计 DSH 插件、评估平台能力边界或排查插件变更未生效时参考。使用时需安装到 DSH profile 并重启；规则依据 DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 核验。

@koanjan/dsh-plugin-boundary is a DSH skill plugin loaded through a profile bundle. It documents Client–Host channels, filesystem API limits, plugin lifecycles, installation, and debugging. Use it to design or troubleshoot plugins. Install in a profile and restart; rules target DSH 0.1.0-rc.6.

怎么排查 DSH 插件的服务在运行时是否真的可用？
Can a DSH client plugin read file contents from the host machine?
How should I check whether a Client–Host channel is officially supported?
Why does my plugin change still look stale after reinstalling or refreshing?
What happens to a dynamically defined plugin after DSH restarts?
@koanjan/dsh-plugin-boundary 的功能「技能目录注册」：插件注册一个名为 dsh-plugin-boundary 的技能，提供用途说明、适用时机和资源目录，供模型或用户调用。
@koanjan/dsh-plugin-boundary 的功能「边界规则按需提供」：技能读取总览及 rules 目录中的规则文件，将内容封装为资源片段返回，涵盖通信、文件系统、插件生命周期和调试。
@koanjan/dsh-plugin-boundary 的功能「profile bundle 安装」：Cordis patch 将插件行插入 profile composition，以 bundle 配置加载插件。
@koanjan/dsh-plugin-boundary 的边界规则注明依据 DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 核验，升级 DSH 后应重新核对关键结论。

@koanjan/dsh-plugin-boundary README · @koanjan/dsh-plugin-boundary：DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin development boundary skill plugin.

Packages the platform's capability boundary rules into a single loadable skill, for trade-off decisions before developing a plugin: which channels are officially supported, which are undocumented workarounds, and which are physically impossible.

@koanjan/dsh-plugin-boundary README · Features：Registers 1 skill via `ctx.skills.registerProvider`:

| Skill | Content |
|---|---|
| `dsh-plugin-boundary` | Client↔Host data channel landscape, official API filesystem limits, dynamic vs bundle plugin lifecycle, install/effect/debug hard rules |

A skill = `SKILL.md` (purpose / when to load / usage points) + `rules/*.md` (boundary rule bodies).
@koanjan/dsh-plugin-boundary README · Features：> Version note: the boundary conclusions are verified against DSH 0.1.0-rc.6; re-verify critical rules against the current version after a DSH upgrade.
@koanjan/dsh-plugin-boundary README · Install：Requires [pnpm](https://pnpm.io/) (the official dependency of `dsh plugin`).

@koanjan/dsh-plugin-boundary README · From the npm registry (after publishing)：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @koanjan/dsh-plugin-boundary
```

After install, **restart DSH**; the `dsh-plugin-boundary` skill should appear in the skill catalog of new sessions.

@koanjan/dsh-plugin-boundary README · Development：```
dsh-plugin-boundary/
├── package.json        # Package manifest; dsh.bundle.patch declares this package as a profile bundle layer
├── cordis.patch.yml    # Patch layer: inserts the plugin row into the profile composition
├── lib/index.js        # Plugin body: skills.registerProvider provides the skill

@koanjan/dsh-plugin-boundary README · Development：- Modifying skill content: edit `skills/dsh-plugin-boundary/SKILL.md` and `rules/*.md` directly, then reinstall (`remove` + `add`) and restart DSH.
- Modifying provider logic: edit `lib/index.js`, then reinstall the same way.
